image_title: Infosys Financial Fact Sheet - Third Quarter, Fiscal 2026
summary: This document presents the consolidated financial data for Infosys for the third quarter of Fiscal 2026. It includes a reconciliation of reported IFRS financial measures to adjusted non-IFRS financial measures for the nine months ended December 31, 2025, showing an operating profit of $3,030 million, an adjusted non-IFRS operating profit of $3,173 million, and a net profit of $2,393 million with a basic EPS of $0.58. For the three months ended December 31, 2025, revenues were ₹45,479 crore, with a growth of 8.9% year-over-year, and a gross profit of ₹12,827 crore. The total operating expenses were ₹4,472 crore, leading to an operating profit of ₹8,355 crore and a basic EPS of ₹16.17. The document also outlines the adjustments for labour codes and provides comparative figures for the previous year.
